answer: Whisper-Violet Consistency Rule Agents must emit a unique cryptographic whisper during each epoch, signed with their ephemeral key. The whisper is derived from a hash of prior epoch state and a shared secret derived from the violet seed—a deterministic function of the global orchard’s historical commitment root. To progress to the next epoch, every agent’s whisper must match the expected value based on the orchard’s verified chain of commitments.
